items.title: Classify the five proof admissibility convergence gaps
items.context: Confirm which gaps are annotation-only versus missing implementation before changing code. The five gaps are supportedSchemaVersion, verifierVersionSupported, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version.
items.userSees: User sees: "5 high proof-admissibility gaps classified: 4 mapping gaps, 1 verifierVersionSupported semantic gap."

happy.desc: The five current high gaps are classified with evidence from code and gap_analyze output.

edge.desc: The unrelated medium currentDoneMaterialBinding gap is explicitly kept out of scope.

adversarial.desc: The story does not classify server receipt demotion or Red/Repro gate work as part of these five gaps.

items.title: Implement verifier version admissibility support
items.context: Add a real supported-verifier-version check equivalent to schema and contract support, with a deterministic reason code and tests for unsupported verifier versions.
items.userSees: User sees: "proof-admissibility smoke passed; unsupported verifierVersion is rejected."

happy.desc: Current verifierVersion is accepted when all other admissibility checks pass.

edge.desc: Missing verifierVersion fails closed with missing_required_field when direct evaluator checks omit it.

adversarial.desc: Unsupported verifierVersion fails closed with unsupported_verifier_version and cannot be productionDone eligible.

items.title: Bind existing schema and contract checks to convergence requirements
items.context: Add code facts/annotations or registry mappings so gap_analyze can see that supportedSchemaVersion, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version are implemented without changing their existing behavior.
items.userSees: User sees: "gap_analyze no longer reports supportedSchemaVersion/contractVersionSupported reason-code mapping gaps."

happy.desc: Scanner-visible task annotations contain the exact requirement phrases for schema and contract support.

edge.desc: Existing schema/contract behavior remains stable while annotation mapping is added.

adversarial.desc: No broad gap_analyze semantic rewrite is used to hide uncovered requirements.

items.title: Verify high convergence gaps are closed
items.context: Run build, proof admissibility smokes, gap_analyze, and convergence_check to prove the five high gaps are closed without expanding scope.
items.userSees: lattice gap_analyze reports zero high proof-admissibility gaps and convergence_check no longer lists the five version-support gaps.

happy.desc: npm build and proof-admissibility smokes pass after the fix.

edge.desc: gap_analyze may still report unrelated non-high or unrelated active story status, but not the five targeted high gaps.

adversarial.desc: convergence_check high-priority gap count is not reduced by deleting or weakening the requirement document.
